description: This is a Java source file defining a utility class 'FlagUtils' which provides static methods for querying and managing intent and activity flags within an Android application. It includes methods for discovering flags on intents, retrieving all possible flags, categorizing flags, checking activity manifest flags, and converting naming conventions.

classes.name: FlagUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to query and analyze intent and activity manifest flags in Android.

methods.name: discoverFlags
methods.description: Returns a list of flag names that are active on the provided Intent object by inspecting its flags and matching with declared fields.

methods.name: getIntentFlagsAsString
methods.description: Returns a list of all intent flag field names available in the Intent class.

methods.name: getAllIntentFlags
methods.description: Returns a list of all defined IntentFlag enum values.

methods.name: intentFlagsByCategory
methods.description: Organizes all intent flags into categories based on their suffixes, returning a map of category names to lists of flag strings.

methods.name: hasIntentFlag
methods.description: Checks if a given Intent object has a specific flag set, identified by name.

methods.name: hasIntentFlag (overloaded)
methods.description: Checks if a given Intent object has a specific IntentFlag enum value set.

methods.name: hasActivityFlag
methods.description: Determines if a specific activity component has a given ActivityFlag based on its manifest flags.

methods.name: getActivityFlags
methods.description: Retrieves the set of ActivityFlag enums representing the manifest flags of a specified activity.

methods.name: loadActivityInfo
methods.description: Internal method that loads activity information from the package manager if not previously loaded.

methods.name: getActivityFlags (overloaded)
methods.description: Detects and returns ActivityFlags set on a provided ActivityInfo object as a list of string descriptions.

methods.name: camelify
methods.description: Converts a snake_case string to a camelCase string.

methods.name: getFlagForString
methods.description: Maps a string representing a flag name to the corresponding IntentFlag enum.
